newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong to get 20 bln won bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong to get 20 bln won bank loan.

text.p: Chohung Bank said on Wednesday it had recently approved an application by debt-ridden Ssangyong Motor Co for a 20 billion won loan.
"The company's application has recently been approved at our bank's loan screening committee," said an official at Chohung Bank's public information department.
Separately Chohung recently supplied another 20 billion won to Ssangyong by purchasing commercial papers issued by the company, the official said.
Ssangyong, a unit of the nation's sixth-largest Ssangyong Group, has been struggling under heavy debts after recording losses for several years.
